task.title: Bug: $__multiVar breaks on variable values that contain spaces
task.body:
`$__multiVar(qualifier,$var)` expands each selected value to `qualifier:value` without quotes. If a value contains a space, GitHub search treats only the first word as the qualifier value.

With a multi-value variable `labels` set to `good first issue` and `bug`, the query `is:open $__multiVar(label,$labels)` expands to:

```
is:open label:good first issue label:bug
```

GitHub reads this as the label `good` plus the free text `first issue`, so the query misses the issues labeled `good first issue`.

## What you expected

The macro produces `is:open label:"good first issue" label:bug`, which is how GitHub search expects multi-word qualifier values.

## How to reproduce

1. Expand the macro: `is:open $__multiVar(label,$labels)` with `labels` set to `good first issue` and `bug` produces `is:open label:good first issue label:bug`.
2. Run both forms against the GitHub search API, for example on `grafana/grafana`: `is:open label:good first issue` returns 0 issues, and `is:open label:"good first issue"` returns 18.

## Environment

- Plugin version: 2.9.3 (current `main`)
